title: Crimson Dance
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Crimson Dance}}

'''Crimson Dance''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that halves the damage of [[bleeding]], but causes hits to apply an alternative '''Bleeding''' debuff. Enemies take damage from up to 8 stacks of this debuff, but take no extra damage from it while moving. This effectively causes bleeding to be based on 35% of your flat physical attack damage per second, or 280% at 8 stacks.

Crimson Dance bleeding may deal damage alongside regular bleeding, for example from a [[partying|party member]] or [[minion]]. It's also possible for a single player to utilize both types if Crimson Dance is lost or gained periodically (e.g. {{il|Farrul's Pounce}}). 

==Location==
Crimson Dance is located at the middle layer of the southwest part of the tree, to the right of the transition path between [[Duelist]] and [[Marauder]] across {{psl|The Impaler}}.
